output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is multiplied by 10 ** uint256(decimals), which can overflow if initialSupply is large enough.
The transfer function does not check if the contract is frozen, allowing users to transfer tokens to a frozen account.
The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from], which can overflow if balanceOf[_from] is small enough.
The setExchange function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The buyPrice and sellPrice are set using msg.value, which can overflow if these values are set to a large amount.
